exceptions.title: passes disabled to rendered Base UI roots
exceptions.reason: The case renders `CheckboxGroup`, which Vase UI does not have.

exceptions.title: does not set `aria-labelledby` during SSR when legend is absent
exceptions.reason: A server render with no `hydrate()` runs in Node with no DOM. The result differs from Base UI on purpose. A root that the consumer does not name assumes a legend until it is mounted, so the server HTML points at the generated id. An `aria-labelledby` with no valid IDREF gives no name (step 2B of https://www.w3.org/TR/accname-1.2/#computation-steps), so `aria-label` and the native name still apply. A root that has a non-blank `aria-label` or an `aria-labelledby` of the consumer has no generated id in the server HTML. The case "renders the generated id in the aria-labelledby of a root that has no legend" asserts the server HTML. The case "renders no aria-labelledby of its own on a root that the consumer names: $name" asserts that a named root has no generated id. The case "has no aria-labelledby when it has no legend" in `FieldsetRoot.test.tsx` asserts that the mounted root has none.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `disabled` for the state and the context, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the root, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `id` to give it to the root for `aria-labelledby`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the legend, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
